name: image-processing-service
description: Cloudinary-style image processing API with a small web UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @app/api" "npm run dev -w @app/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/web && npm run build -w @app/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
